notes: Pricing Advisor now analyzes saved Experian reports locally without requiring Claude. It uses utilization, inquiries, tradelines, delinquencies, collections, public records, balances, payments, credit depth, and principal report coverage. Pricing remains term-first; tree and neural estimates stay visible, the better holdout amount model drives the recommendation, and all 932 labeled deals are used in the exported model. Claude remains an optional second opinion only.
